import pandas as pd
trips = tables["trips"]
climate = tables["climate"]

t = trips[(trips.fish_date_season==2) & (trips.cls.isin(["three_quarter","overnight","day_1_5"]))].copy()
def bucket(d):
    if d < 30: return "0-29"
    if d < 60: return "30-59"
    if d < 90: return "60-89"
    if d < 120: return "90-119"
    return "120+"
t["bucket"] = t.fish_date_doy.apply(bucket)
agg = t.groupby(["cls","bucket"]).agg(yt=("yt","sum"), anglers=("anglers","sum"), n=("yt","count")).reset_index()
agg["share"] = agg.yt/agg.anglers

oni = climate[climate.index_id=="oni"].sort_values("avail_doy").tail(8)[["avail_season","avail_doy","value"]]

# san diego boat trend, all season
sd = trips[(trips.fish_date_season==2) & (trips.boat=="San Diego") & (trips.cls=="three_quarter")].sort_values("fish_date_doy")[["fish_date_doy","yt","anglers"]]

result = {"class_bucket_share": agg.to_dict("records"), "oni_recent": oni.to_dict("records"), "san_diego_trips": sd.to_dict("records")}

SELECT cls,
  CASE WHEN fish_date_doy >= 107 THEN '14d' ELSE '30d' END AS window,
  SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, COUNT(*) AS n,
  SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS share_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 91 AND 121
  AND cls IN ('three_quarter','overnight','day_1_5','hd_am','hd_pm','hd_twilight')
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT landing, boat, fish_date_doy, yt, anglers, yt*1.0/anglers AS share
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND cls='day_1_5' AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 91 AND 121
ORDER BY fish_date_doy

SELECT avail_doy, value
FROM climate
WHERE index_id='oni' AND avail_season=2
ORDER BY avail_doy DESC
LIMIT 6
